ValidationRule.description: Ensures that once a quote is signed, the Opportunity can only transition directly to 'Closed Won' or 'Closed Lost' and cannot be moved back to any prior pipeline stages.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Quote Signed') && NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Lost')) && NOT(ISCHANGED(SkipValidations__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A quote has already been signed; this Opportunity can only be Closed!
